concerns.text: T021 description ('calculates mean/variance... classifies as rejected/fluctuating/accepted') omits the explicit exclusion logic for 'consistently accepted' (mastered) candidates required by FR-003 and Constitution Principle VI. The task implies classification but fails to mandate the exclusion step, risking a silent relaxation of the CAP mechanism's core constraint.

T026 places Gaussian noise injection (σ=0.05) in `generators.py` (data generation phase). FR-008 explicitly requires noise injection 'at each step' of the simulation to ensure statistical variance in the training loop. Generating noise once at the start violates the per-step stochastic requirement, weakening the statistical validity of the convergence curves.

SC-002 requires measuring the 'Standard Deviation of the AUCC' between variants. T029 (t-test) and T032 (report generation) only mention calculating AUCC difference and p-values. No task explicitly assigns the calculation or reporting of the Standard Deviation of the AUCC distribution, dropping a required acceptance criterion.

The spec's Edge Cases require a specific fallback behavior ('defaulting to the full set') when dynamic pruning results in zero candidates. T020 tests 'empty prompt fallback' generally, and T022 mentions 'min threshold enforcement', but neither explicitly mandates verifying the 'default to full set' logic for the specific high-confidence pruning scenario, risking a silent drift from the spec's edge case handling.
